claim: Patchline ships a mechanized proof that gate-certificate composition forms a lattice with a top safe element. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the lattice claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make certificate-lattice-proof-gate`.
